register.labelZh: DREAM 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: dream of 能幫助你描述自己非常希望將來擁有的生活、工作、住所或經歷。；dream on 能讓你清楚表示,你認為對方所說的事情不可能發生。；dream something away 可以描述一個人只顧幻想,沒有採取行動,因而白白度過數小時、數天,甚至多年。；dream something up 能幫助你描述某人如何構思出新奇的主意、故事、計劃、藉口或設計。
register.summaryEn: Dream of helps you describe the life, job, home or experience that you strongly hope to have one day. Dream on lets you show clearly that you believe another person’s idea will never happen. Dream something away describes a person who spends hours, days or even years imagining things instead of taking action. Dream something up helps you describe how somebody creates an unusual idea, story, plan, excuse or design.
